# Tagwise Identity Protocol (TIP)

> The foundational identity layer for payments on Solana. TIP replaces long wallet addresses with memorable human-readable @tags.

Tagwise Identity Protocol (TIP) is an open-source identity resolution protocol built on the Solana blockchain. It enables wallets, exchanges, merchants, and dApps to resolve human-readable @tags (e.g., @alice) to Solana wallet addresses, making crypto payments as simple as sending to a username.

## Key Features

- **Human-Readable Addresses**: Replace complex wallet addresses with memorable @tags
- **On-Chain Resolution**: Identity data is stored directly on Solana via Program Derived Addresses (PDAs)
- **Open-Source SDK**: TypeScript/JavaScript SDK available on npm as `@tagwise/tip-sdk`
- **REST API**: HTTP endpoints for tag resolution, identity lookup, search, QR codes, and payment links
- **Wallet Authentication**: Challenge–response auth using Solana wallet signatures
- **Payment Links & QR**: Generate payment links and QR codes for any registered @tag
